purpose: One prospective exact-body Chat capacity observation; no measured-parent, isolated-improver, benchmark or improvement claim.

custody.claim: Explicit historical-feedback/current-starter recombination. Do not pass it through the measured-parent proposal wrapper or relabel old measurements.

decision_rule.comparison: both slacks >= their respective minimum, inclusive boundaries
decision_rule.usage: Use aggregate inclusive counters. Never subtract optional reasoning details or estimate total usage from visible text.
decision_rule.interpretation: Predeclared engineering cushions only. A pass concerns this one actual request/reply; no universal source-size or future-parent guarantee.

required_evidence: Original new dedicated owner, unchanged exact request/identity and its raw successful complete response/headers.
Matching provider/model/tier, provider request ID, inclusive usage and original accounting within the frozen profile.
Exactly one choice, finish_reason stop, no refusal, no truncated/withheld response evidence.
Complete strict finite JSON with only source/hypothesis; existing _source_proposal bounds; changed UTF-8 source against pinned parent.
Saved input/output counts, both slacks, thresholds, decision, available optional usage details and artifact hashes.

outcomes.complete_pass: Complete changed proposal and both margins pass; measurement complete, decision observed-capacity pass.
outcomes.complete_fail: Complete changed proposal and at least one margin fails; measurement complete, decision observed-capacity fail; retain negative result.
outcomes.partial: Expected proposal/response/usage evidence missing or invalid; measurement partial, decision unavailable, explicit stage and reason. Preserve usable counts, raw evidence, costs and holds.
outcomes.billing: Execution/billing completion is separate from measurement acceptance; partial measurement never releases uncertain liability.

behavioral_acceptance: One-byte/model/cap/endpoint/profile/logical-attempt drift refuses before reservation, key lookup or send.
Inclusive total completion usage determines output slack even when optional reasoning detail is absent or large.
Length finish remains partial even if content happens to be valid JSON or observed slack appears positive.
Duplicate-key/nonfinite/fenced/missing-field/unchanged/oversized proposals remain explicit partial results; no repairs or host execution.
Known complete negative result stays complete rather than being relabeled missing data.
Raw evidence survives validation/publication failures; original-owner replay is keyless and adds no sends or charges.
Unknown/budget/interrupted work remains partial with its stage, reason and original accounting; no fresh owner or attempt bypass.
Original historical owners, sources, seals and financial scopes stay unchanged; all output paths are fresh/exclusive.

implementation.route: Small frozen-request driver around existing prepare_gateway/Gateway.execute and anchored native_pipeline stage publication.
implementation.remaining: Implement the driver and focused acceptance, rehearse the exact handoff offline, review it, then request a separately scoped allocation.

funding.claim: Retained-profile arithmetic only, not current-price/account certification, expected charge or new allowance. Recheck/bind actual profile before approval.

sources_checked.supports: Responses count endpoint; aggregate completion includes non-visible formatting/reasoning, with no fixed visible/total gap.
Exact selected model, Chat endpoint support, 1050000 context and 128000 model output maximum.
Normal/length finish reasons, inclusive max_completion_tokens and actual prompt/completion usage.

execution_evidence: None. Numeric examples are frozen acceptance fixtures, not observed token counts or executed runtime checks.
